description: This file declares functions and structures related to URL parsing and encoding, including URL validation, decoding, and manipulation functions. It serves as a header for URL processing utilities.

methods.name: is_url
methods.description: Checks if the given string is a valid URL.

methods.name: is_urlschemechar
methods.description: Determines if a character is valid within a URL scheme.

methods.name: url_decode_mem
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string with specified length.

methods.name: url_percent_decode
methods.description: Decodes percent-encoded sequences in a URL, including sequences before the colon.

methods.name: url_decode_parameter_name
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded parameter name from query string.

methods.name: url_decode_parameter_value
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded parameter value from query string.

methods.name: end_url_with_slash
methods.description: Appends a slash to the URL stored in a strbuf structure.

methods.name: str_end_url_with_slash
methods.description: Creates a new string with a slash appended to the provided URL.
